# HexPiece 3.0.5

Your two right-click notes. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass.

- **First person: your arm shows during the right click.** The mod hid your own hand while the laser charged and fired, to draw an
  arm of its own in its place, and on your device that arm never showed, so there was no arm at all. Now your own first-person
  arm always stays (the same for the sword's moves), and the light gathers at, and the laser leaves from, its fingertips.
- **The held right click's blast is much bigger and throws much harder.** Its range is now 5 blocks at the smallest charge, about 9
  at half and 13 at a full charge (it was 3, 5 and 7), and it throws whoever is in it about twice as hard. The explosion you see grew
  to match.
